name: CertChain
tagline: Tamper-proof academic credentials, verified in seconds
problem: Fake degree, marksheet and internship certificates keep fooling recruiters
A doctored PDF takes minutes; manual college verification takes days to weeks
Phone/email checks leave no audit trail and can be socially engineered
Central databases must be trusted blindly - insider edits are invisible

stats.label: manual verification turnaround via the college (approx.)
to doctor a certificate PDF with free tools (approx.)
cryptographic checks on a typical paper certificate

solution: Each college signs certificates with its own Ed25519 key
Records are Merkle-sealed into a hash-linked, PoW-mined permissioned chain
Recruiters scan a QR code: VALID / REVOKED / INVALID with 7 explained checks
Signed on-chain revocations; tampering pinpoints the exact broken block

features.title: Issue & bulk CSV
features.desc: Form or CSV batch -> one mined, signed block per batch

features.title: Printable cert + QR
features.desc: QR code from our own pure-Python encoder, ID and 8-char verify code

features.title: Explainable verify
features.desc: Hash, Merkle proof, block hash, PoW, signature, anchoring, revocation

features.title: Revocation registry
features.desc: Issuer-signed revocations recorded on-chain; only the issuer can revoke

features.title: Tamper demo
features.desc: Edit a CGPA in chain.json and watch the exact block and link break

features.title: Block explorer
features.desc: Linked block cards with hashes, nonces, signatures and check status

architecture: Browser SPA (vanilla JS) -> verify, issue, explorer, tamper, security
service.py -> issue, bulk, revoke, verify, tamper, restore
chain.py -> blocks, PoW, full-chain validation, explainable verify
ed25519.py + merkle.py + qr.py -> crypto from scratch on hashlib
algorithms: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) – issuer signatures on blocks and revocations
SHA-256 canonical-JSON hashing with 128-bit salt – record fingerprint
Merkle tree + inclusion proofs – verify one cert against a header
Proof-of-work (4 hex zeros) – cost to rewrite history
Full-chain validation – links, PoW, roots, signatures, rules
QR encoding with Reed-Solomon GF(256) – scannable verify link
tech: Python 3 stdlib only (hashlib, http.server, json, csv)
Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, inline SVG, no CDN
Runs fully offline on any laptop
innovation: All crypto hand-built and checked against RFC 8032 test vectors
Verification explains which guarantee failed and why it matters
Self-contained certificate bundle: Merkle proof + signed header
Two-level attacker demo shows why each security layer exists
demo_flow: Load demo data -> verify a genuine KSRCE degree: VALID, 7 ticks
Forged JSON (CGPA edited) -> INVALID at Merkle proof; fake ID -> NOT FOUND
Issue a certificate -> mined + signed -> printable page with QR
Bulk issue 5 certificates from CSV in one block
Tamper: edit CGPA in chain.json -> block 1 Merkle root breaks
Re-mine attack -> signature + block 2 link break; restore
Close on the threat model: forgery, tampering, insider, key theft
impact: Honest graduates no longer undercut by forged credentials
Colleges stop answering verification emails one by one
Recruiters verify instantly and offline, for free
Tiny energy use: ~40 ms of CPU per block, no public mining
business: Free public verification for recruiters drives adoption
Annual issuance licence per institution, with ERP/CSV integration
Paid bulk-verification API for job portals and BGV firms
White-label for skill and bootcamp certificate issuers
future: Multi-node replication and BFT consensus across a consortium
Key rotation, HSM signing and on-chain key-compromise records
Selective disclosure: prove the degree without revealing CGPA
W3C Verifiable Credentials and DigiLocker export
